email.subject1: a signal play for Gnosis Freight
email.body1:
Michael, saw Gnosis Freight made G2's 2026 Best Software Awards and the Top 100 Fastest Growing Products list.

Momentum like that usually surfaces more in-market shippers and forwarders than the team can cover before they cool, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Gnosis off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michael, quick follow-up for Gnosis Freight.

After a growth investment and award momentum, the pipeline target climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Gnosis needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Michael, last bit of proof for Gnosis Freight.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Gnosis's reply rate likely compares to other logistics-software companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michael, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most mid-growth-stage, and I know running GTM through a fast-growth stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a logistics-software motion? I will tailor it to Gnosis either way.
